Ask about the Blood Barrier — talk to Hort's Apparition, talk to Wiste's Apparition (Kibelisk: Collapsed Hall of Fame)

Weaken the Subspace Aura — destroy the Incomplete Subspace Rift, defeat Remnant of Subspace, defeat the Balaur Dispatch (Kibelisk: Collapsed Hall of Fame)
Turn in — Nemon, Collapsed Hall of Fame
Blood Barrier.notes: Giver place not stated (only 'Altgard'); place inferred from giver Kibelisk = previous quest's turn-in. Turn-in Kibelisk distance not listed.

Zikel's Core.notes: Metabot conflict: turn-in step gives Kibelisk Outskirts Stall 93 m (after 'go to the outskirts of the Impetusium'), NPC table lists Black Claw Village. turninPlace left null. Step 2 'enter the Impetusium' is 368 m from Collapsed Hall of Fame.

items: class-specific Spiritforged weapon (Assassin variant not named on page)

Investigate Draupnir (Kibelisk: Garden of the Illusion God East Observatory)

Forgotten Commander.notes: Unlocks at 45 (all earlier 40-45 story quests say unlocks at 10). Steps are in Altgard; turn-in is in Chaotic Lower Reshanta, so the Altgard story ends here.
Forgotten Commander.end: leaves Altgard: turn-in at Latesran Eastern Root, Chaotic Lower Reshanta. Metabot next = 'Daeva Trapped in a Nightmare' (https://metabot.gg/en/aion-2/quests/daeva-trapped-in-a-nightmare), not covered.
